note: Dwarf warrior facing front, unarmed hands. Hair, big beard and the two braids are head; beard bottom y~498 at centre, left braid to y~528, right braid to y~540. Green tunic, leather harness, belt (y~600-655), the axe head tucked at the belt, pouches, kilt and the purple cape behind are torso; the kilt hem y~736 is the hip. Arms: bare shoulder skin and the purple pauldron are upper arm down to the elbow (left y~568, right y~570, where the green bracer layer starts); the green bracer layer is forearm; wrists left y~632 / right y~644 where the bare fists begin. Bare thighs y736-774 below the kilt, knees at the boot top y~774; boot shafts are lower leg; ankles at the instep (left y~820, right y~818). No held equipment (the belt axe head is worn, so torso).
